verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Smooth publishes an llms.txt at docs.smooth.sh (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as markdown pages. The docs themselves are served as .md URLs, and there are agent-specific setup guides for Claude Code and other CLI-capable agents. One community comment notes the docs pages are not very token-efficient, which is a minor caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or similar consolidated agent bundle, and independent corroboration that the docs are optimized for agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.smooth.sh/llms.txt # Smooth
Ask Claude to do something on the web. It will use Smooth automatically.
Smooth CLI works with any agent that can run CLI commands.
